description: Tabtivity default capabilities — commands and window management. Scoped by WEBVIEW label, deliberately: per tauri-utils' own `Capability::windows` doc, a window pattern enables the capability on ALL webviews of that window regardless of `webviews`, so a `windows` glob is an over-grant the moment a window ever holds a second webview. Every window Tabtivity creates goes through `WebviewWindowBuilder`, which gives the webview the same label as the window, so this list is behaviour-identical to the old `windows` one for `main`, `detached-*` and `present-*`. There is no `remote` key here and there must never be one — a `remote` entry is the single line that would hand a browsed page the Tauri IPC bridge. `src-tauri/tests/capability_scope.rs` fails if any of that is undone.
